mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.content,e.plain_content plainContent,e.content_format contentFormat,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.tag_name ORDER BY t.tag_name SEPARATOR '||') tagsText,e.create_time createTime FROM user_record_entry e LEFT JOIN user_record_entry_tag et ON et.entry_id=e.id LEFT JOIN user_record_tag t ON t.id=et.tag_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND (#{keyword}='' OR e.plain_content LIKE #{keywordLike}) AND (#{tag}='' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_record_entry_tag xt JOIN user_record_tag x ON x.id=xt.tag_id WHERE xt.entry_id=e.id AND x.user_id=#{userId} AND x.tag_name=#{tag})) GROUP BY e.id,e.content,e.plain_content,e.content_format,e.create_time ORDER BY e.create_time DESC,e.id DESC

SELECT e.id,e.content,e.plain_content plainContent,e.content_format contentFormat,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.tag_name ORDER BY t.tag_name SEPARATOR '||') tagsText,e.create_time createTime FROM user_record_entry e LEFT JOIN user_record_entry_tag et ON et.entry_id=e.id LEFT JOIN user_record_tag t ON t.id=et.tag_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.id=#{id} GROUP BY e.id,e.content,e.plain_content,e.content_format,e.create_time

SELECT t.tag_name name,COUNT(et.entry_id) useCount FROM user_record_tag t LEFT JOIN user_record_entry_tag et ON et.tag_id=t.id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY t.id,t.tag_name ORDER BY useCount DESC,t.tag_name
mapper.update: UPDATE user_record_entry SET content=#{content},plain_content=#{plainContent},content_format='RICH_TEXT' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_record_tag WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND tag_name=#{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_record_entry_file(entry_id,user_id,file_id) SELECT #{entryId},#{userId},id FROM file_record WHERE id=#{fileId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='0'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_record_entry_file WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND entry_id=#{id}
DELETE et FROM user_record_entry_tag et JOIN user_record_entry e ON e.id=et.entry_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.id=#{id}
DELETE FROM user_record_entry WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
